body:
LRU KV admission previously lacked a safe bound for future typed Plan workspace, and capacity reuse could precede source transport completion. This change adds a compiler capacity-only lifetime bound before SRAM candidate filtering, installs immutable finite-manifest rank margins, rejects out-of-bound Plans before acquisition, and gates capacity consumers on source store/migration completion. Existing Plan hashes/summaries, the old envelope ABI, and OFF emission remain unchanged.

The new active JOINT gets additive typed-task, shared Runtime, workspace and bridge-v3 seams with legacy compatibility fixtures. Its sh30 native-projection guard remains enabled: production business integration and native-world parity are unfinished. The old JOINT archive is untouched. Formula-first modeling guidance, current HANDOFF, reproducible evidence and valid research are preserved for account relay.

Validation: public Release/default build and 30/30 CTest; 62/62 complete Plan identities; 224 old envelope responses and 16 expected errors unchanged; LRU Python 182 passed / 2 documented skips, focused C++ checks, and two actual Online runs with 480/560 typed Plans below their bounds; new JOINT 6 focused C++ binaries, Python 45/45 without skips, and 14-op real ABI smoke. Five canonical manifests match; current config checks cover four variants (70 tests), not all 83. No new development tests were started after the stop instruction.

Production E5 timing/busy accuracy remains failed, E8/E16 and target held-out samples are unavailable, TX8/reference and target priors remain frozen, and host-overhead/full-business acceptance is incomplete. User explicitly requested this GitHub handoff and immediate stop after merge and remote verification.
title: Add workspace capacity bounds, LRU admission and new JOINT seams
